intro.text: Ruen, the Eelakin scientist in charge of research on Patji: short, bald and sharp-nosed, and much chattier than any trapper.

items.text: When Dusk asked how things float in the dark beyond the perpendicularity, Ruen showed him a glowing paste made from the worms that live there. For all his time there, he still gets a mouthful of water each time he crosses over, which he finds funny.

He fed the glowing worms to other ravens, hoping to recreate Sak's talent, but decided Sak was unique. He thinks Shadesmar is the endless dark of the old stories, and although his team had found no way to cross it, he shared Dusk's belief that Cakoban had done so long ago.

appearance.text: He is bonded to a tall Aviar with a large crest on its head.
